source: Existing frozen sport_events basketball_bsn export. No new collection approved by this protocol.
registration: Written before running this pilot. Archive existence and a few outcomes already inspected; not preregistered unseen evidence.
cutoff: All features use strictly earlier America/Puerto_Rico calendar dates, no same-day updates. Source-generated midnight timestamps are not verified tipoff times.

policies.rule: 1500 initial Elo, K32, no home advantage. Date-batched updates; both teams need at least 3 prior decisive games; abstain if pHome=0.5.
Compare wins/played in each team's last 5 decisive games, both need 3. Abstain on exact equal rates. Ranking score, not calibrated probability.
Expected home=(home last5 pointsFor + away last5 pointsAgainst)/2; away symmetric. Both need 3 prior games. Select larger score, abstain on equality; report margin/total MAE.

data_gates: Distinct canonical IDs, season, date and final nonnegative integer scores. Quarantine conflicting ID or duplicate economic event records. Preserve inputs and hashes. Phase unknown remains explicit.
evaluation: Per-policy W/L, coverage, date/team counts, win-rate Wilson interval, same-intersection HOME comparator, forecast rows with input IDs and feature last date. No optimization, no promotion.
roi: UNAVAILABLE unless independently audited exact market/price/book/as-of evidence is provided. Never substitute prices, assume -110, or infer sportsbook ROI from score accuracy.
future: Expand only with licensed/permissioned/open data or attested operator files. Freeze subsequent development/confirmation periods before search; do not reuse this pilot as independent confirmation.
